description:
This is a configuration management library, offering unified access to
		configuration properties from system properties, environment variables,
		.properties files, and YAML files. It supports prefix-based property
		resolution, flattening of hierarchical YAML into dot-separated keys, and
		typed property retrieval (String, int, long, boolean). The library is
		extensible via the Configurator interface and the
		AbstractFileConfigurator abstract class, enabling custom configuration
		sources and file format support. It uses SnakeYAML for YAML parsing and
		is distributed under the Apache License 2.0. Suitable for Java
		applications requiring flexible, pluggable configuration loading and
		resolution.
